# Original Libretro overlay configuration fixtures

Unmodified files from libretro/common-overlays, commit
`42c21b99889468a8e77fd7f002229ec16e2f9fa2`:

- `psx.cfg`: `gamepads/flat/psx.cfg`, libretro contributors.
- `rgpad_modern.cfg`: `gamepads/rgpad/rgpad_modern.cfg`, RGPAD 1.5 by DJM.

Source: https://github.com/libretro/common-overlays

Images are downloaded from the same pinned revision only for CI previews.
